## Rating

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple" title="Met"}
The code regenerates every table and figure in the paper and appendix, and each matches the published one in structure (rows, columns, panels) and content; for figures, the levels, shapes and positions of curves and data points are the same. Only cosmetic differences remain (fonts, colors, layout).
:::
::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple" title="Partially met"}
Some display items are regenerated and match, while others are missing (no code produces them, e.g. made by hand) or deviate; or items are regenerated with minor deviations that do not change what they show (e.g. slightly shifted points because no random seed was set, a difference of a few observations).
:::
::: {.callout-important appearance="simple" title="Not met"}
The code regenerates none of the tables and figures, or the regenerated items differ substantially from the published ones (different structure, trends or shapes).
:::

[Based on: [#85](../../sources.qmd#p85 "The Role of Third-Party Verification in Research Reproducibility") level, shapes and positions of curves/data points, [#20](../../sources.qmd#p20 "Successes and struggles with computational reproducibility: lessons from the fragile families challenge")/[#93](../../sources.qmd#p93 "Unintended code errors and computational reproducibility") all figures and tables incl. appendix, [#99](../../sources.qmd#p99 "Introducing reproducible research standards at the world bank") match exactly, [#104](../../sources.qmd#p104 "Reproduce to validate: a comprehensive study on the reproducibility of economics research") match up to some decimals, [#109](../../sources.qmd#p109 "A protocol for structured robustness reproductions and replicability assessments") 'Fully' identical vs. 'Partially' slight deviation, [#103](../../sources.qmd#p103 "The Challenges of Replicating Volatile Platform-Data Studies: Replicating Schatto-Eckrodt et al. (2020)") random seed for figures, [#132](../../sources.qmd#p132 "Long-term effects of the targeting the ultra poor program—a reproducibility and replicability assessment of banerjee et al. (2021)") negligible discrepancies (two observations).]{.source-note}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Not applicable"}
C3 (no tables/figures)
:::
